metadata.prompt:
Question: In Table 1 of the EIA Kentucky Electricity Profile 2024, what net generation in megawatthours is listed for Electric utilities?

A. 65,645,705 megawatthours
B. 1,305,143 megawatthours

Source citation: Kentucky Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/kentucky/index.php)

Source text:
Kentucky Electricity Profile 2024

Table 1. 2024 Summary statistics (Kentucky)

| Item | Value | Rank |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Net summer capacity (megawatts) | 18,380 | 24 |
| Electric utilities | 17,074 | 17 |
| IPP & CHP | 1,307 | 47 |
| Net generation (megawatthours) | 66,950,848 | 22 |
| Electric utilities | 65,645,705 | 14 |
| IPP & CHP | 1,305,143 | 49 |

Data source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-860, Annual Electric Generator Report, U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-861, Annual Electric Power Industry Report, U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-923, Power Plant Operations Report and predecessor forms.

Supplied draft answer: B

output_text:
**Answer: A**

**Reason:** The supplied draft answer (B) is incorrect. According to Table 1 of the Kentucky Electricity Profile 2024, under "Net generation (megawatthours)," the value for Electric utilities is 65,645,705, while IPP & CHP is 1,305,143. The draft answer selected the IPP & CHP value instead of the Electric utilities value.

**Evidence quote:** "Net generation (megawatthours) | 66,950,848 | 22 | Electric utilities | 65,645,705 | 14 | IPP & CHP | 1,305,143 | 49"
